scope: Modular native runs with appended independently metered per-execution ITP; original native decisions and source/goal evidence preserved.
cost_policy: Times are nested, not additive. Display means of per-execution time and peak RSS. Historical proof costs are not charged as new execution costs.

additional_native_diagnostics.scope: Additional native diagnostics only. Each entry-exit diagnostic includes one rejected output-root configuration attempt and one actual execution; no additional logical benchmark input and no replacement for original all-boundaries.

native_scope: Modular native supplement. CN/QCP/Fulminate historical evidence is referenced by the primary group table. Pending ITP is not successful detection.
